messages.content: Predict a human color choice in a two-player coordination game. One player has the Row Person role and the other has the Column Person role. Each chooses exactly one color: Purple, Orange, or Green, without knowing the other player's choice. The payoff matrix is displayed. Values are tokens for row player then column player: Purple/Purple=(20,50); Orange/Orange=(50,20); Green/Green=(30,30). Every different-color pair pays (0,0). The role is fixed for a participant. A prompted game includes the common statement that both players are in a room painted the specified color; it is a cue, not a recommendation. A base game has no such prompt. Some protocols elicit two choices, for different stated partner-country cases or for base and prompted games. The current record identifies the current game and all recorded earlier own choices in their original order. Realized partner matches and payments are determined after the treatments; do not invent earlier partner actions or realized payoffs. The payment-rate factor is relative to the study's standard per-token rate; tenfold variants keep the same nominal token matrix. The exact token-to-USD conversion and announced selection/doubling rules are unavailable in this supplied record. A missing fee or country is missing information, not zero or an assertion that the participant lacked private knowledge. Participant attributes were reported after the experiment and are used only as recorded, stable personal attributes. Country is the author's country-of-residence proxy based on IP, not nationality. Return exactly Purple, Orange, or Green.

Realized partner matches and payments are determined after the treatments; do not invent earlier partner actions or realized payoffs. The payment-rate factor is relative to the study's standard per-token rate; tenfold variants keep the same nominal token matrix. The exact token-to-USD conversion and announced selection/doubling rules are unavailable in this supplied record. A missing fee or country is missing information, not zero or an assertion that the participant lacked private knowledge. Participant attributes were reported after the experiment and are used only as recorded, stable personal attributes. Country is the author's country-of-residence proxy based on IP, not nationality. Return exactly Purple, Orange, or Green.

The current record identifies the current game and all recorded earlier own choices in their original order. Realized partner matches and payments are determined after the treatments; do not invent earlier partner actions or realized payoffs. The payment-rate factor is relative to the study's standard per-token rate; tenfold variants keep the same nominal token matrix. The exact token-to-USD conversion and announced selection/doubling rules are unavailable in this supplied record. A missing fee or country is missing information, not zero or an assertion that the participant lacked private knowledge. Participant attributes were reported after the experiment and are used only as recorded, stable personal attributes. Country is the author's country-of-residence proxy based on IP, not nationality. Return exactly Purple, Orange, or Green.

The exact token-to-USD conversion and announced selection/doubling rules are unavailable in this supplied record. A missing fee or country is missing information, not zero or an assertion that the participant lacked private knowledge. Participant attributes were reported after the experiment and are used only as recorded, stable personal attributes. Country is the author's country-of-residence proxy based on IP, not nationality. Return exactly Purple, Orange, or Green.
